151850.title: The Cascades at Tivoli, with a Storm Approaching
151850.creator: Abraham Teerlink

editorial.note: The cascades (cascatelle in Italian) at Tivoli were already a tourist attraction in Teerlink’s time. The artist incorporated this contemporary activity in a view of the famous waterfalls.

The tiny figures in this grand landscape with a rushing waterfall are almost lost. The composition is dominated by gnarled trees, barren tree trunks, and roiling water. The dramatic cycle of nature’s birth and decay is almost tangible.
Roelant Roghman (1627 - 1692). Mountainous landscape with fisherman, c. 1660. Purchased in 1972.
